{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsorlift transport''' was a form of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle used to transport objects or beings.

Repulsorlift transports were also manufactured as platform-type vehicles, such as wagons. One such '''repulsorlift wagon''', armored and under heavy [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]], was used in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] to transport the [[All Planets Relief Fund]] treasury of [[Crystalline vertex/Legends|crystalline vertex]] to a [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core]] vault, in the [[Bank of the Core Plaza]], on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref>

One such transport was produced by [[TerraTech]]. [[Jowart Typok]] had a modified version of this vehicle, the ''[[Reptor]]''.
